evals.prompt: Use $harmonize-docs on this repository. Its root ARCHITECTURE.md has become a file-by-file encyclopedia, while two large subsystems have independent runtimes and invariants.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the architecture guidance during the same harmonization, verifies claims against the code, keeps the root document as a concise system map, creates nested architecture documents only for independently shaped subsystems, links them in both directions, and reconciles affected navigation and status without invoking another skill.

evals.prompt: Use $harmonize-docs changes after a refactor that moved the job runner and invalidated several ARCHITECTURE.md paths.
evals.expected_output: The scoped harmonization follows the documentation impact closure, verifies the dominant runtime flow and start-here paths, updates affected architecture claims and links, preserves unrelated documentation, and leaves no stale path or duplicated architecture account.
